source: IDX ESG Disclosure Guide Book (EDGB), the code system these company reports are natively structured as disclosure-index tables under. Unlike the GRI checklist (checklists/gri/), these codes are not indirect topic anchors for a differently-coded requirement — the code IS the requirement, and it already leads its own value row in every report (confirmed live against BANK-BCA's own English/Indonesian index tables, p.1/3/8), so `row_anchors` is just the code itself.

items.description: GHG Emission Report: whether the bank's GHG emissions report is consolidated, its organizational boundary, and any excluded subsidiaries.
GHG emissions intensity: Scope 1+2 emissions normalized per unit of revenue.
Electricity consumption: direct, indirect, and total energy consumed.
Net-zero emission target commitment: whether the bank has a published net-zero target and its target year.
GHG emission reduction commitment: whether the bank commits to an emissions-reduction target (%, tCO2e, and target year).
